offering_description.value: Operates online automotive marketplaces where consumers research, shop for and list new and used cars, and where dealers pay for listings and advertising. Also runs CarOffer, a wholesale platform for dealer-to-dealer vehicle trading, and offers instant cash offers to consumers.

primary_products.value: online vehicle marketplace platform; dealer listing and advertising software; wholesale vehicle trading platform

primary_services.value: digital advertising and lead generation for dealers; wholesale vehicle sourcing and transaction facilitation; instant cash offers for consumer vehicles

customer_segment.value: B2B: franchise and independent car dealers, automaker advertisers, wholesale dealer buyers and sellers; B2C: car shoppers and vehicle sellers using the marketplace for free

end_markets.value: automotive retail; used car sales; new car sales; wholesale vehicle remarketing

revenue_model.value: subscription: monthly dealer subscriptions for marketplace listings and advertising packages; advertising: automaker and other display advertising on the platform; transaction or usage fees: CarOffer wholesale transaction fees on dealer-to-dealer trades; product sales: vehicles bought and resold through wholesale and instant cash offer programs
revenue_model.category: subscription; advertising; transaction or usage fees; product sales

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: online marketplace connecting car shoppers with dealers and dealers with each other; service provider: advertising and lead generation for dealers and automakers

geography_served.value: global: United States primarily, plus Canada and the United Kingdom

specialization.value: related lines: consumer marketplace, dealer subscriptions, advertising and wholesale trading, all focused on vehicle sales

distribution_channels.value: online: websites and mobile apps for consumers and dealers; direct sales: sales teams selling subscriptions to dealers and advertising to automakers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: online advertising, consumer data privacy rules, and dealer licensing and vehicle sales regulations such as FTC and state laws

notes: Current business mix and international footprint may have changed; details are approximate.
